name: kural
description: The company's only mouth — the word faculty — on Google ADK. A Claude-via-Vertex Envoy Lead qualifies an approved campaign; two Gemini scouts research audience and timing in parallel; a Gemini writer drafts founder-voice outreach grounded in the manas Context Pack; a Claude-via-Vertex Claim-Judge fact-checks every claim at a numeric gate (claim_support >= 0.80) and loops the draft back to be re-grounded until it verifies or rolls back; the run HALTS at the founder's publish sign-off before anything reaches the world. kural authors the words, fact-checks them, and sends as the buyer behind an eligibility/value-cap gate and a no-double-send ledger (the channel keys are custodied by manas); it never edits kalai's creative. kural AUTHORS and ENGAGES.

skills.name: Launch a campaign
skills.description: Take an approved decision + kalai's compliance-cleared master, qualify the engagement, research audience and timing in parallel, write founder-voice outreach grounded in the manas Context Pack, fact-check every claim at the claim_support >= 0.80 gate, and HALT at the founder's publish sign-off. Accepts and holds the campaign at the gate; the founder's tap-2 puts it live. Sends as the buyer behind an eligibility/value-cap gate and a no-double-send ledger. No creative is edited; nothing is published without the gate.
examples: Announce: Raise Pro to $34, grandfather existing subscribers, 30-day notice.
Announce the new annual Pro plan.

notes: Discovery card, served by the one FastAPI service at /api/kural/agent-card. ADK's to_a2a() is blocked by the a2a-sdk 1.1.0 restructure, and the JSON-RPC task-receive endpoint is NOT yet wired — today the same skill surface is carried by the in-process dispatch registry (common/a2a.py), call-identical to a live A2A endpoint so wiring real transport changes only this layer.
